title: AI指南与报告资源合集仓库
summary: 该GitHub仓库汇集了与人工智能、机器学习、智能体AI、AI Agent、深度学习和大语言模型相关的报告与指南列表，为学习和研究AI提供参考资料。
summary_en: A GitHub repository collecting lists of reports and guides related to AI, machine learning, agentic AI, AI agents, deep learning, and LLMs, serving as reference material for AI learning and research.
